definitions.explanation: A relationship or bond between people, things, or concepts; the state of being connected or related.

examples.japanese: {結|むす}びつき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}い。
{地域|ちいき}と⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結|むす}びつき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}に⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To value the ties with the local community.

examples.japanese: {因果|いんが}{関係|かんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結|むす}びつき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調|しら}べる。

notes:
{結|むす}びつき refers to connections or ties between things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結|むす}びつきが{強|つよ}い (strong connection)
- {結|むす}びつきが{深|ふか}い (deep connection)
- {結|むす}びつきを{持|も}つ (to have a connection)
- {結|むす}びつきを{強|つよ}める (to strengthen ties)

RELATED TERMS:
- {結|むす}びつく: to be connected (verb)
- {結|むす}びつける: to connect (verb)
- {関係|かんけい}: relationship
- {つながり}: connection, link
- {絆|きずな}: bond
